_comment: Sample RPM artifact manifest for openssl-libs. Cryptography library — exactly the kind of OS package that benefits from M-of-N hash pinning (XZ-style supply chain attacks land here first).
name: openssl-libs

metadata.note: Crypto libraries are the highest-risk RPM category. Communities should set their `packages/system/install` policy threshold higher for these — typically 4 of 5 or 5 of 7 — than for application packages.
